decision_conditions:
The use hereby permitted shall not be open to customers outside the following times: 08:00
hours to 20:00 hours, Monday to Sunday inclusive, including Bank Holidays&nbsp;without the prior written permission of the local planning authority.
Storage shall not take place anywhere within the application site except within the building(s).
The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

The development hereby permitted shall be carried out in accordance with the following approved plans and documents:&nbsp;Form 4 Reasonable Exception Statement, LBH/PP/HTC-K-001, LBH/PP/HTC-K-002 (Proposed Site Plan), LBH/PP/HTC-K-002 (Proposed Site Plan with Temporary Ramps), LBH/PP/HTC-SK-001, LBH/PP/HTC-SK-002, London Borough of Harrow Kiosks on St. Anns Road Design and Access Statement November 2024, TQRQM24318114502169.

The
materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the
extension hereby permitted shall have a steel structure frame and cladded with
external aluminium panels powder coated in RAL4005 (purple).

<p>Prior
to the first occupation of the development hereby permitted, until details of a
waste management plan have been submitted to and approved in writing by the
Local Planning Authority. The waste management plan shall be carried out in
accordance with the approved details.</p>

<div>The premises shall be used for the following purposes as set out in the use classes order 1987:</div><div><br></div><ul><li>E(a) - retail sale of goods;</li><li>E(b) - sale of food and drink;</li><li>E(g)(i) - Offices to carry out any operational or administrative functions;</li><li>E(c)(iii) - Other appropriate services in a commercial, business or service locality; and</li><li>Sui Generis - hot food takeaways (for the sale of hot food where consumption of that food is mostly undertaken off the premises);</li></ul><div><br></div><div>and for no other purposes, including any other purposes of the Schedule to the Town and Country Planning (Use Classes) Order 1987 (or in any provision equivalent to that Class in any Statutory Instrument revoking and re-enacting that order with or without modification) without the prior written approval by the Local Planning Authority.</div><div><br></div><div>REASON - To safeguard the amenity of neighbouring residents and the character of the locality, the character and viability of the shopping parade, and in the interests of highway safety.</div><div><br></div>
description: Demolition of two kiosks; installation of four modular kiosks with retractable awnings and access ramps to front elevation for flexible use as either Class E(a) Retail sale of goods, E(b) Sale of food and drink, E(g)(1) office to carry out administrative functions Sui generis, (r) hot food takeaway for the sale of hot food

open_spaces_details.description: 4 kiosks replacing 2 existing kiosks for business use located on St Anns Road pedestrianised part of Harrow Town Centre.

application_details.scheme_name: Business Kiosks St Anns Road Harrow Town Centre

waste_details.reason_for_no_provision: A shell only installation will be provided, including connections to water and electricity. All recycling and waste storage will be installed by the future operator as it will their responsibility to do it.
